description.value:
Iconic EQ Very Heavy Pistol (w/ Tech Rebuild). Holds 4 rounds. Incompatible with Capacity modifying Attachments. Sets damaged targets Seriously on Fire. Can be charged without a Move Action. Requires BODY 10+ or a Cyberarm when fired for its user to not suffer the Broken Arm Critical Injury.

Variant of: Burya
Category: Luxury
Fabrication: DV29 - 5,000eb - 1 Month
Class: Very Heavy Pistol
Range: Long Barrel Pistol
Pre-installed: Tech Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)

Foundry notes:

  • Damage is 5d6, dropping the lowest die. CPR 0.92.4 can't drop dice automatically, so drop them by hand from the damage roll.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Luxury benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
